title: Uniqueness of minimal presentations of q-transversal matroids
statement: Let $M$ be a $q$-transversal matroid with a presentation by a system of subspaces. A presentation is **minimal** if no member can be replaced by a proper subspace while preserving the represented matroid. **Uniqueness of minimal presentations.** Minimal presentations are unique. The claim is stated without evidence of resolution in the supplied text and is therefore open.
source_name: Mark Saaltink, “A theory of q-transversals”, arXiv:2503.12201 (2025).
references:
Source: https://arxiv.org/abs/2503.12201
